blitz_preferences_percentage_ranges.name: blitz_preferences_percentage_ranges
blitz_preferences_percentage_ranges.value:
"blitz_preferences"."remix_percentage" between 0 and 100
          and "blitz_preferences"."own_media_percentage" between 0 and 100
          and "blitz_preferences"."mention_business_percentage" between 0 and 100
          and "blitz_preferences"."influencer_chance" between 0 and 100

content_text_boxes_background_shape.name: content_text_boxes_background_shape
content_text_boxes_background_shape.value:
"content_text_boxes"."background" is null
          or (("content_text_boxes"."background"->>'opacity')::numeric between 0 and 1
              and "content_text_boxes"."background"->>'style' in ('pill', 'full-width'))

posts_account_type_matches.name: posts_account_type_matches
posts_account_type_matches.value:
("posts"."account_type" = 'oauth' and "posts"."connection_id" is not null)
          or ("posts"."account_type" = 'warmed' and "posts"."warmed_account_id" is not null)

quota_ledgers_counters_non_negative.name: quota_ledgers_counters_non_negative
quota_ledgers_counters_non_negative.value:
"quota_ledgers"."content_saves_included" >= 0 and "quota_ledgers"."content_saves_used" >= 0
          and "quota_ledgers"."content_saves_purchased" >= 0 and "quota_ledgers"."overage_units" >= 0
          and "quota_ledgers"."daily_swipes_used" >= 0 and "quota_ledgers"."ai_credits" >= 0
          and "quota_ledgers"."warmed_post_slots" >= 0

judgment_records_metrics_non_negative.name: judgment_records_metrics_non_negative
judgment_records_metrics_non_negative.value:
("judgment_records"."input_tokens" is null or "judgment_records"."input_tokens" >= 0)
          and ("judgment_records"."latency_ms" is null or "judgment_records"."latency_ms" >= 0)
